# Web3 Research Vault & Learning Archive

> Curated open-access digital archive containing 368+ peer-reviewed academic manuscripts, institutional market audits, protocol whitepapers, and technical reports in Web3, Crypto, DeFi, and Blockchain by Akash Kumar Jha (YourWeb3Guy Team).

## Core Links
- Interactive Learning Hub: https://www.yourweb3guy.com/learn
- Full Sitemap & Directory: https://www.yourweb3guy.com/sitemap
- Research & Editorial News: https://www.yourweb3guy.com/news
- GitHub Source Repository: https://github.com/Akash1070/web3-research-vault

## Repository Content
- Research Papers: 44 peer-reviewed academic manuscripts on cryptography, consensus, zero-knowledge proofs, and modular scaling.
- Whitepapers: 10 foundational protocol whitepapers including Bitcoin, Uniswap, Aave, 0x, Polkadot, and Ripple.
- Blockchain: 22 protocol security audits, smart contract vulnerability taxonomies, and infrastructure reports.
- Crypto: 79 institutional market intelligence audits and tokenomics frameworks.
- Metaverse & NFT: 41 reports on digital asset standards, game theory, and token dynamics.
- Paris Blockchain Society Open Library: 174 volumes of preserved European blockchain analysis.
